lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible; a central primary row contains the largest local maxima, with subordinate rows of smaller clusters located both dorsally and ventrally to the midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance pixels on the upper edge to low-luminance shadow pixels on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating an area of previous tissue loss or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated piscine silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the immediate proximity of the pectoral fin's insertion point and trailing edge.
